searchText: I initially 👍-ed it, but then when I say "instruction swap thirteen", which one do I really mean 😭 ? yeah this is an issue i also have doubts about whether it's fine to disassemble code in a way that you can't tell what exact instruction was in the original bytecode. but i'm not sure if this is an issue. perhaps if relative jumps are expressed as numbers rather than labels I would say go with the 'verbatim' option For EXCHANGE, an assembler will very likely want to have special support for encoding the two immediate operands, even though it's technically just one immediate. In geas, I would probably use the syntax ``` exchange 3, 4 ```
